title: Signature 04 · Glamour Hourglass · Irezumi Waves · Cream Studio
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her late 20s, long glossy black waves, pulled over one shoulder so the back is uncovered.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. Glamour hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an overwhelmingly enormous full bust, a waist cinched so impossibly tiny it is barely a third of the width of her hips, hips flaring to nearly twice the width of her shoulders, thighs thicker than her waist pressing together, soft full voluptuous curves everywhere. Not skinny, not a runway model, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body Japanese irezumi body painting painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. A bright indigo and white ground of continuous curling white-crested waves with vermilion and gold wind bars and scattered cherry petals. The waves spread wide across the bust and hips and narrow across the tiny waistline. A large continuous design spreads across the whole back and down over the hips and the backs of the thighs. Not black shading, no dragons, no koi. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing with her back three-quarters to the camera, looking back over her shoulder with a smile, one arm hanging away from the body, the painted back, tiny waist, and flaring hips fully visible.

Footwear: Extremely high vermilion lacquer platform stiletto mules. Nails: extra long almond, vermilion with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: A seamless warm cream studio backdrop with no props, the background much lighter than her body, soft warm light from one side carving the impossibly tiny waist, making the glossy colors gleam, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
